$comment: Verified in Phase 0 against source and the staging database, 2026-11-14. 'live' = present in the production build (web from main) and the released Android app. 'branch_only' = complete and staging-tested on the production branch, not yet deployed. Academy articles for a feature that is not 'live' must not be published to production users.
